title: The Unsaid Aftermath
author: Oscar Okafor
blurb: Gideon Vasquez, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
